findings.reason: the section must name the routing conjunction (`_use_local` / `_is_local_api_base`) as the suppression gate, or state why the model prefix alone is the correct discriminator, so suppression cannot diverge from routing.
findings.text: §22 says a model served by the dedicated local client, identified by the predicate `_is_local_client_model` (llm.py:947, a `local/`/`hosted_vllm/` prefix test), "never sends `response_format`", but the actual decision that a request is served by the dedicated local client is the conjunction `_use_local = _is_local_client_model(model) and _is_local_api_base(api_base)` (llm.py:2259, 2451, 2907). Gating suppression on the prefix alone forks the locality decision: a `local/*` or `hosted_vllm/*` model routed through litellm (no `api_base`) would lose its `response_format` and fall back to prompt-injected schema while its transport never took the local branch the change exists to protect, and any future local prefix would silently affect non-local routing; the plan itself asserts "OpenRouter models are unchanged", which only holds if suppression is bound to the same predicate that selects the local client.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; the abort behaviour lands in llm.py, the owner of the structured-call loops, and the reset/paths changes land in reset.py and query_builder.py, each of which already hides its record shape and call loop behind a small interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §22 gates its new response_format suppression on `_is_local_client_model` alone (llm.py:947), a prefix test, while the owner of the "this request is served by the dedicated local client" decision is the routing conjunction `_use_local = _is_local_client_model(model) and _is_local_api_base(api_base)` at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2259, so the plan forks that decision instead of extending it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — this week's figures are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §22 states it adds no error family (reusing `EmptyResponseError`) and adds no CLI option or MCP view, and §14's remaining nodes edit existing config/CLI values (`discovery_roots`, `--root`/`--path-prefix`) and add only tests, so no section adds surface to any family without accounting for it.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §22 extends existing machinery rather than rebuilding it: the structured-call retry contract already exists (`EmptyResponseError` at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:475, its `empty response content` message already a member of `RETRYABLE_PATTERNS` at llm.py:718 with no `NON_RETRYABLE_PATTERNS` entry matching `abort`), and the schema-injection path already exists (`schema_needs` frontmatter and the shared partial providers in imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py:367,1041,1361); §14 reuses `render_path_prefix_clause` (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268), `reset_to_status` (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:59), `get_facility` (imas_codex/discovery/base/facility.py:113) and `seed_facility_roots`, all of which exist and are the named owners.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §22's local-transport change extends `_build_kwargs`/`_completion_local`/`_local_call_kwargs` in place (llm.py:1974,190,146) and states why the engine cannot take `response_format` (the xgrammar `Grammar accept_token failed` abort), so the added conditional is justified rather than a parallel layer.
